faq.q: How much does Hirsch & Lyon Accident Law charge?
faq.a: Hirsch & Lyon Accident Law publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Hirsch & Lyon Accident Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Hirsch & Lyon Accident Law publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Hirsch & Lyon Accident Law have offices?
faq.a: Hirsch & Lyon Accident Law publishes one office, in Phoenix. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Hirsch & Lyon Accident Law?
faq.a: Hirsch & Lyon Accident Law names two attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Arizona does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
